name: com.blackveilsecurity/dns
title: BlackVeil DNS & Email Security Scanner
description: DNS and email security scanner with 82 MCP tools for SPF, DMARC, DNSSEC, SSL, and brand audits.

tools.name: get_access_context
tools.description: Read the effective authentication context for this request: tier, owner-IP-gate disposition, a keyed pseudonymous principal reference, server version and observation time. Performs no target checks or quota/session/cache/job writes. An unavailable result is not anonymous/free fallback.

tools.name: check_mx
tools.description: Look up MX records for a domain. Identifies which mail servers receive inbound email for the domain and which email hosting provider is used (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Proofpoint, etc.). Use when asked which email provider hosts inbound mail for a domain, or to see MX record configuration. Part of scan_domain.

tools.name: check_spf
tools.description: Look up and validate the SPF record for a domain. Lists all IP addresses and third-party senders authorised to send email on behalf of the domain, flags syntax errors, and shows the trust surface (which mail servers are whitelisted). Use when you need to know who is permitted to send email as a domain. Part of scan_domain.

tools.name: check_dmarc
tools.description: Look up and validate a domain's DMARC record: enforcement level (none/quarantine/reject), alignment mode, and aggregate/forensic reporting destinations. Use to find a domain's DMARC enforcement, whether it sends aggregate reports, or whether it is protected against email impersonation; not check_shadow_domains (TLD variants) or assess_spoofability (composite score). Part of scan_domain.

tools.name: check_dkim
tools.description: Look up DKIM records for a domain. Probes common selectors, validates the signing algorithm used for outgoing email (RSA-1024/2048, Ed25519), and reports key strength. Use to verify that outbound email signatures are cryptographically sound. Part of scan_domain.

selector.description: DKIM selector. Omit to probe common ones.

tools.name: check_dnssec
tools.description: Check DNSSEC status for a domain. Verifies whether DNS is tamper-proof and protected against cache poisoning and DNS spoofing attacks by validating DNSKEY and DS records. Reports whether DNSSEC is enabled and validating. Part of scan_domain.

tools.name: check_ssl
tools.description: Check HTTPS/TLS posture: reachability, HSTS, HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect, and certificate issuer, expiry and SAN count from CT logs (the latest LOGGED certificate, which may differ from the one served). servedCertificate gives the issuer and expiry of the one actually SERVED on port 443, or not_assessed with a reason. TLS versions and cipher suites are not assessed. Part of scan_domain.

tools.name: check_mta_sts
tools.description: Check whether a domain enforces SMTP TLS for inbound mail via MTA-STS, protecting against downgrade attacks. Queries _mta-sts.<domain> and fetches the policy file, reports mode (enforce/testing/none) and MX coverage. Use to verify whether inbound SMTP is protected against TLS downgrade or MITM — distinct from check_dane which uses TLSA pinning. Part of scan_domain.

tools.name: check_ns
tools.description: Audit a domain’s nameserver delegation and redundancy. Identifies the DNS hosting provider and, when the infrastructure probe is available, directly compares parent and child NS sets, verifies authoritative AA responses, and checks required glue addresses. Use to detect stale registrar delegations, lame nameservers, and intermittent resolution risk. Part of scan_domain.

tools.name: check_caa
tools.description: Look up CAA records for a domain. Shows which Certificate Authorities are authorized to issue certificates. Part of scan_domain.

tools.name: check_bimi
tools.description: Check the BIMI record at default._bimi.<domain>: validates the logo URL (l=), the presence of mark-certificate authority evidence (a=; a bare URL, so VMC vs CMC is not determined), and the DMARC enforcement prerequisite (p=quarantine/reject) mail clients require. Use to assess brand-logo readiness in inboxes. Part of scan_domain.

tools.name: check_tlsrpt
tools.description: Check whether a domain has SMTP TLS Reporting (TLS-RPT) configured. Queries _smtp._tls.<domain> for the v=TLSRPTv1 record and validates its reporting destination (rua= mailto:/https:), flagging a missing record, duplicate records, or an invalid/absent reporting URI. Complements MTA-STS by giving visibility into TLS delivery failures. Part of scan_domain.

tools.name: check_http_security
tools.description: Audit browser-facing HTTP security headers over HTTPS: Content-Security-Policy (unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval/wildcards), X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and COOP/COEP/CORP; also detects CDN/WAF interception. Returns per-header findings for missing or weak protection against XSS, clickjacking and cross-origin attacks. Part of scan_domain.

tools.name: check_dane
tools.description: Check DANE/TLSA pinning for SMTP: looks up TLSA records at _25._tcp.<mx-host> for each MX and validates their fields and DNSSEC backing. Records are reported present but UNVERIFIED: there is no port-25 certificate probe, so a pin is never compared to the certificate actually served. Use for SMTP DANE; use check_dane_https for port 443. Part of scan_domain.

tools.name: check_ptr
tools.description: Verify forward-confirmed reverse DNS (PTR/FCrDNS) for mail servers. Part of scan_domain.

tools.name: check_dane_https
tools.description: Verify DANE/TLSA pinning for HTTPS (port 443): looks up TLSA records at _443._tcp.<domain> and validates fields and DNSSEC backing. Reported present but UNVERIFIED in every deployment: comparison with the served certificate is withdrawn (the probe cannot observe the origin certificate), so a stale pin is NOT detected. Use check_dane for SMTP. Part of scan_domain.

tools.name: check_svcb_https
tools.description: Validate HTTPS/SVCB records (RFC 9460) for modern transport capability advertisement. Part of scan_domain.

tools.name: check_lookalikes
tools.description: Detect active typosquat and lookalike/homoglyph domains that impersonate your brand and could be used in phishing. Identifies character-substitution and visual-confusion domains registered by attackers. Distinct from check_shadow_domains (TLD variants with auth gaps) and discover_brand_domains (legitimate brand portfolio).

tools.name: check_subdomailing
tools.description: Detect SubdoMailing risk: analyzes the SPF include chain for dangling or hijackable subdomains that could let an attacker send email as the domain. Use when you want to know if an SPF include chain can be hijacked through a dangling domain, or to detect subdomain mailing risk hidden in SPF includes. Part of scan_domain.

tools.name: scan_domain
tools.description: Run a full DNS and email security audit for one domain across every scan-included check (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, DNSSEC and more); returns an overall score, NIST-aligned letter grade (A+ to F), maturity stage and prioritized findings. Use for a comprehensive audit, overall grade or email security maturity level. Cite scoringConfigHash with a score; model and engine versions are not comparable.

tools.name: batch_scan
tools.description: Bulk-scan up to 10 domains in parallel with a full security audit each; returns score, NIST-aligned letter grade (A+ to F) and finding counts per domain. Use to audit several domains at once; batch_scan_start runs it as an async job; compare_domains compares 2-5 side by side. scoringModelVersion (policy) is independent of dnsChecksPackageVersion (engine); cite scoringConfigHash with scores.

tools.name: batch_scan_start
tools.description: Async form of batch_scan (1-10 domains) for clients with short call timeouts. Returns jobId: poll batch_scan_status with it as job_id, then batch_scan_findings (kept 7 days). idempotency_key: any stable string you choose; replaying it with the same domains returns the same job.

idempotency_key.description: Any stable 8-128 char string; reuse with the same domains returns the same job.

tools.name: batch_scan_status
tools.description: Poll a batch_scan_start job by job_id: queued, running, completed or failed, plus any error or unscanned domains. Owner-scoped: other callers get not found.

tools.name: batch_scan_findings
tools.description: Fetch per-domain results of a batch_scan_start job by job_id once status is completed. Owner-scoped; kept until expiresAt (7 days).

tools.name: compare_domains
tools.description: Side-by-side security comparison of 2–5 domains. Shows relative scores, category gaps, and unique weaknesses for each domain. Use when comparing your security posture against a competitor, or doing a head-to-head comparison between multiple domains.

tools.name: compare_baseline
tools.description: Compare a domain's current security configuration against a fixed policy baseline to determine compliance. Use to check whether a domain meets a policy requirement — not for tracking improvement/regression over time (use analyze_drift) and not for comparing multiple domains (use compare_domains).

baseline.description: Required-controls policy (grade/score floors, require_* flags). Not a prior scan; see analyze_drift.

tools.name: check_shadow_domains
tools.description: Find alternate TLD variants of a domain (e.g. example.net, example.co) that have weak or missing email authentication and could be used to spoof email. Use when asked about TLD variants with email auth gaps — distinct from check_lookalikes which detects typosquat/homoglyph impersonation domains.

tools.name: check_txt_hygiene
tools.description: Audit a domain's TXT records for stale entries and SaaS exposure (old verifications, clutter, misplaced DMARC). Use for TXT cleanup; check_zone_hygiene covers subdomains and SOA.

tools.name: check_mx_reputation
tools.description: Check whether a domain's mail server (MX) IPs are on spam blocklists: for up to 3 MX hosts, queries SpamCop and Barracuda (not Spamhaus ZEN) and verifies reverse DNS (PTR/FCrDNS) per host. Use to ask if your mail server IP is blacklisted. check_rbl takes the same domain and queries more RBLs (6), without PTR.

tools.name: check_srv
tools.description: Map a domain's DNS-visible service footprint by probing 19 common SRV prefixes (email, calendar, messaging, directory, web) in parallel; returns discovered services and flags insecure advertisements such as plaintext IMAP/POP3/LDAP with no encrypted variant. No match among probed prefixes is not proof the domain has no services. Use to map DNS-visible services.

tools.name: check_zone_hygiene
tools.description: Audit DNS zone hygiene: identifies sensitive or forgotten subdomains exposed in DNS, stale SOA records, and zone propagation issues. Use to find any sensitive subdomains that should not be publicly visible, or to audit overall DNS zone cleanliness.

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Generate a DNS/email security remediation artifact. Artifact types: spf_record (build a new SPF record), dmarc_record (create a DMARC policy), dkim_config (DKIM key setup), mta_sts_policy (generate an MTA-STS policy file), fix_plan (prioritized remediation plan for all findings), or rollout_plan (phased DMARC enforcement timeline). Use when asked to generate or create a record or policy.

mx_hosts.description: mta_sts_policy: MX hosts. Omit to detect from DNS.

force_refresh.description: fix_plan: bypass cache and run a fresh scan.

tools.name: get_domain_rank
tools.description: Rank a domain against its country or global cohort using the GSI benchmark corpus. Accepts a domain score (from scan_domain) and optional country/sector; returns a percentile: "scores better than X% of peers". Owner-gate exempt — public cohort data only.

domain.description: Domain to rank against its cohort (e.g., example.com)

score.description: Domain score (0–100) from scan_domain. Used to compute the cohort percentile.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to use the country cohort (e.g., "NZ"). Omit for global cohort.

sector.description: Sector label, e.g. "finance". Accepted but not yet used to filter the cohort.

tools.name: get_benchmark
tools.description: Get industry benchmark data: shows what percentile a domain's security score ranks at within its sector or country cohort, the mean score, and the most common DNS security failures across the industry. Use when asked how a score compares to the industry average, what percentile a score is in, or what the most common security failures are in an industry or sector.

tools.name: get_provider_insights
tools.description: Get security benchmarks and common configuration issues for a specific email or DNS service-provider cohort (e.g. Google Workspace customers, Microsoft 365 customers). Use when asked how an email service provider compares to competitors on security posture, or to see typical misconfigurations for a named vendor's customers.

tools.name: assess_spoofability
tools.description: Compute a composite email spoofability risk score (0-100, higher = more spoofable) from SPF trust surface, DMARC enforcement and DKIM coverage. Returns a risk level (minimal to critical), per-control sub-scores and a plain-language summary. Use when asked how easy it is to spoof email from a domain, or for a composite spoofing risk score.

tools.name: check_resolver_consistency
tools.description: Check DNS consistency across 4 public resolvers (Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, OpenDNS) for A/AAAA/MX/TXT/NS or one record_type. Use when answers differ by resolver.

tools.name: explain_finding
tools.description: Explain a finding from scan_domain or a check_* tool: pass its category as checkType, severity as status, detail text as details. Returns explanation, impact, remediation and references.

tools.name: map_supply_chain
tools.description: Map DNS-visible third-party service dependencies for a domain. Correlates SPF, NS, TXT verifications, SRV services, and CAA records to reveal which third-party vendors can send email as the domain, control DNS, or access integrated services. Use when asked to map third-party or supply-chain dependencies — not for listing who can send email (use check_spf for that).

tools.name: analyze_drift
tools.description: Measure whether a domain's DNS security posture improved or regressed versus a prior scan snapshot; returns a drift classification (improving/stable/regressing/mixed), score delta, and lists of improvements and regressions. Use for "did our score improve or regress since last time?"; not compare_baseline, which checks compliance with a fixed policy.

baseline.description: Prior ScanScore JSON string, or "cached" (default) for the last cached scan. Not a policy object.

tools.name: validate_fix
tools.description: Re-check a specific security control after applying a fix, to confirm the finding is now resolved. Use only when a fix has already been applied and you want to verify or confirm the remediation was successful — not for initial inspection of a record.

domain.description: Domain to validate the fix for

expected.description: Expected DNS record value to verify against

tools.name: resolve_spf_chain
tools.description: Trace the full SPF include chain for a domain. Recursively resolves all includes, shows lookup count, tree depth, and flags circular includes or exceeding the 10-lookup limit.

tools.name: discover_subdomains
tools.description: Find subdomains via Certificate Transparency logs to reveal shadow IT and forgotten services. Returns a CT SAMPLE, not an asset inventory: counts are a lower bound, hosts without a logged certificate never appear, and a per-source `coverage` record states what was consulted. `countBasis` marks totalSubdomains as `sample` or a cut-recall `floor`; `concreteSubdomains` excludes wildcards.

tools.name: map_compliance
tools.description: Map scan findings to compliance frameworks: NIST 800-177, PCI DSS 4.0, SOC 2, CIS Controls. Shows pass/fail/partial status per control.

tools.name: sge_quickscan
tools.description: Check whether ONE domain meets the New Zealand Secure Government Email (SGE) requirements due October 2026. Reports seven controls (DMARC p=reject, SPF -all, DKIM, SMTP transport TLS, MTA-STS enforce, TLS-RPT, sub-domain coverage) as satisfied, not satisfied or NOT MEASURED, with evidence. A DNS-only result tops out at INDETERMINATE, which is not a pass. Not map_compliance (NIST/PCI/SOC 2/CIS).

tools.name: prioritize_portfolio_leads
tools.description: Rank a brand’s portfolio (or an explicit domain set) into prioritized registrar-partner sales leads by product-gap value × severity. Multi-domain, paid. Reuses map_registrar_products per domain, then ranks. Distinct from map_registrar_products (per-domain product mapping) and batch_scan (raw scores).

domains.description: Explicit domain set to rank (max 10). Ownership bucket = "unknown".

brand.description: Brand seed apex; discovers the portfolio, derives ownership buckets, then ranks the top candidates.

tools.name: simulate_attack_paths
tools.description: Analyze current DNS posture and enumerate specific attack paths an adversary could exploit, with severity, feasibility, steps, and mitigations.

tools.name: check_dbl
tools.description: Check domain reputation against DNS-based Domain Block Lists (Spamhaus DBL, URIBL, SURBL). Returns listing status with decoded return codes.

tools.name: check_rbl
tools.description: Check a domain's mail server IP against 6 DNS blocklists (SpamCop, UCEProtect L1/L2, Mailspike, Barracuda, PSBL): takes a domain, resolves its MX hosts (else A records) to IPv4s. More lists than check_mx_reputation, which adds rDNS checks.

tools.name: cymru_asn
tools.description: Map domain IPs to Autonomous System Numbers via Team Cymru DNS. Returns ASN, prefix, country, registry, and organization for each IP. Flags high-risk hosting ASNs.

tools.name: rdap_lookup
tools.description: Fetch domain registration data via RDAP (modern WHOIS replacement). Returns the domain registrar (the company the domain was registered with), registrant contact, creation/expiration dates, EPP status codes, and domain age. Use when asked who registered the domain, who the registrar is, or when the registration expires — distinct from check_ns which identifies the DNS nameserver provider.

tools.name: check_realtime_threat_feed
tools.description: Check a domain against BlackVeil real-time threat intelligence (curated intel-gateway feed). Distinct from DNSBL checks. Operator-deploy only; degrades to info when unprovisioned.

tools.name: check_nsec_walkability
tools.description: Assess zone walkability risk by analyzing NSEC3PARAM configuration. Detects plain NSEC zones, weak NSEC3 parameters, and opt-out flags. Use to ask if zone names can be enumerated; other DNSSEC tools cover status, chain and keys.

tools.name: check_dnssec_chain
tools.description: Walk the full DNSSEC chain of trust from the DNS root down to the target domain, tracing DS/DNSKEY records and algorithm usage at each zone level. Use when asked to trace the chain of trust from the DNS root, or to see the full DNSSEC delegation path step by step.

tools.name: check_agent_discovery
tools.description: Assess IETF BANDAID agent-discovery DNS records: finds SVCB agent records under _agents, reports whether the discovery zone is DNSSEC-anchored (unsigned means spoofable endpoints), evaluates DANE/TLSA binding trust and checks capability-document integrity (cap / cap-sha256). Read-only; uses Private-Use SVCB param code points pending IANA assignment.

protocol.description: Limit to one agent protocol (a2a, mcp or https). Omit to sweep all.

name.description: Resolve a single named agent ({name}.{domain}) instead of enumerating the zone.

verify_cap.description: Fetch each cap= capability document over HTTPS and check its cap-sha256 pin. Default false.

tools.name: check_llms_txt
tools.description: Inspect a domain's /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt for links and install commands an AI agent could inherit. Sweeps external link hosts for dangling CNAMEs and deprovisioned-service fingerprints (evidence, not proof it is claimable) and checks npm/PyPI install package names for unregistered names and OSV malicious-package advisories. Detection only, not scored; notAssessed lists unmeasured items.

tools.name: check_dnskey_strength
tools.description: Audit DNSKEY signing algorithms used for DNSSEC: reports the algorithm in use (RSA/SHA-1, RSA/SHA-256, ECDSA P-256, Ed25519, etc.) and flags deprecated ones (RSA/SHA-1, DSA), independent of whether the chain validates. Use when asked which algorithm signs DNSSEC keys or if deprecated DNSKEY algorithms are in use. Part of scan_domain.

tools.name: check_fast_flux
tools.description: Detect fast-flux DNS behavior: performs multiple rounds of A/AAAA queries and checks whether IP addresses are rotating rapidly on each DNS query (a sign of botnet or malicious infrastructure). Compares IP answer sets and TTLs across rounds to identify rapidly rotating infrastructure used to hide malicious activity.

tools.name: check_subdomain_takeover
tools.description: Sweep subdomains for dangling CNAMEs pointing at deprovisioned cloud services an attacker could claim (subdomain takeover); detects 16 provider families such as AWS S3/CloudFront, Azure, GCP Storage, Heroku, GitHub Pages, Vercel and Firebase. Use when asked if subdomains point to deprovisioned services. Pair with discover_subdomains to widen candidates (it returns a CT sample).

subdomains.description: Explicit subdomains to sweep (FQDNs or short labels; max 1000). Default: a 15-name built-in list.

tools.name: check_authoritative_dns_infra
tools.description: Measure a hostname's authoritative DNS posture by querying its nameservers directly over TCP/53 from one vantage: reachability, AA flag, recursion exposure, SOA serial consistency, DNSKEY/RRSIG presence (not validation), IPv4/IPv6 parity. Authenticated callers also get a zone-transfer refusal test (no zone data retrieved) and CHAOS disclosure. UDP, BGP, RPKI, anycast not measured.

tools.name: check_root_server_set
tools.description: Query a rotating sample of 3 root servers per call and compare the priming NS set, glue, SOA serials, and cross-root consistency against the embedded official root hints. Uses BV_INFRA_PROBE when available; without it, returns the embedded hints as reference data only.

tools.name: discover_brand_domains
tools.description: Discover all domains that belong to a brand's portfolio by aggregating certificate, DNS, redirect, and mail-policy signals. Use when asked what domains are part of a brand portfolio, or to find all domains related to a brand. Pass the EXACT seed domain verbatim — do NOT normalize or substitute a canonical domain.

domain.description: Seed domain, used verbatim: never normalize or swap in a canonical domain (clau.de stays clau.de).

signals.description: Signal modules to invoke. Defaults to all 12 discovery/enrichment signals.

depth.description: Discovery depth. standard is default; deep expands candidate seeding and enrichment fanout.

planner_mode.description: Discovery planner: observe emits metrics; enforce applies candidate-backed signal caps.

brand_aliases.description: Optional public brand aliases to seed, such as product or legal-entity labels.

candidate_domains.description: Optional candidate domains supplied by the caller for corroboration.

dkim_selectors.description: Optional DKIM selectors to probe. Defaults to a built-in common-selector list.

min_confidence.description: Drop candidates whose combined confidence falls below this threshold (0-1, default 0.5).

discovery_mode.description: "classic" (default) runs the public signal sweep; "tiered" adds private-binding tier lookups first.

ownership_verified.description: Attest you own or may scan the seed domain. Required for "tiered" unless enterprise/owner/partner.

tools.name: discover_brand_domains_start
tools.description: Start an async brand-domain discovery for the EXACT seed domain provided (the async sibling of discover_brand_domains, which can run ~24s and time out interactive clients). Same args as discover_brand_domains. Returns { auditId, queuedAt, etaSeconds }; pass auditId as operationId to discover_brand_domains_status (poll) and discover_brand_domains_findings (ranked candidates).

domain.description: Seed domain, used verbatim: never normalize or swap in a canonical domain (clau.de stays clau.de).

signals.description: Signal modules to invoke. Defaults to all 12 discovery/enrichment signals.

depth.description: Discovery depth. standard is default; deep expands candidate seeding and enrichment fanout.

planner_mode.description: Discovery planner: observe emits metrics; enforce applies candidate-backed signal caps.

brand_aliases.description: Optional public brand aliases to seed, such as product or legal-entity labels.

candidate_domains.description: Optional candidate domains supplied by the caller for corroboration.

dkim_selectors.description: Optional DKIM selectors to probe. Defaults to a built-in common-selector list.

min_confidence.description: Drop candidates whose combined confidence falls below this threshold (0-1, default 0.5).

discovery_mode.description: "classic" (default) runs the public signal sweep; "tiered" adds private-binding tier lookups first.

ownership_verified.description: Attest you own or may scan the seed domain. Required for "tiered" unless enterprise/owner/partner.

tools.name: discover_brand_domains_status
tools.description: Poll the status of an async brand-domain discovery started with discover_brand_domains_start. Returns status (queued | running | completed | failed) and progress. Owner-scoped — operationIds owned by other principals surface as notFound.

tools.name: discover_brand_domains_findings
tools.description: Fetch the ranked candidate domains (the discovery CheckResult) for an async run started with discover_brand_domains_start. Returns notReady while the discovery is still in-flight; the discovery result once complete. Owner-scoped.

tools.name: brand_audit_single
tools.description: Run a full brand audit on one target (optional standard/deep depth, brand aliases, candidate domains). Discovers brand-related domains, looks up registrar and registrant, and classifies each as consolidated, shadowIt, authorized vendor, indeterminate or impersonation. Gated by monthly BRAND_AUDIT_QUOTAS (free/agent=0, developer=50, partner=200, enterprise=500, owner=unlimited).

min_confidence.description: Drop candidates whose combined confidence falls below this threshold (0-1, default 0.5).

depth.description: Discovery depth. standard is default; deep expands candidate seeding and enrichment fanout.

planner_mode.description: Discovery planner: observe emits metrics; enforce applies candidate-backed signal caps.

brand_aliases.description: Optional public brand aliases to seed, such as product or legal-entity labels.

candidate_domains.description: Optional candidate domains supplied by the caller for corroboration.

discovery_mode.description: Discovery pipeline: classic = legacy sweep; tiered = tenant/graph/evidence lookups first.

ownership_verified.description: Attest you own or may scan the target. Required for "tiered" unless enterprise/owner/partner.

tools.name: brand_audit_batch_start
tools.description: Enqueue an async brand audit across up to 50 target domains with optional standard/deep discovery depth, brand aliases, and caller-supplied candidate domains. Returns { auditId, queuedAt, targetCount, etaSeconds } immediately; poll with brand_audit_status and fetch results with brand_audit_get_report once complete. Each target consumes 1 unit of the monthly BRAND_AUDIT_QUOTAS budget.

domains.description: Domains to audit (max 50 per batch). Duplicates are merged.

min_confidence.description: Drop candidates whose combined confidence falls below this threshold (0-1, default 0.5).

depth.description: Discovery depth. standard is default; deep expands candidate seeding and enrichment fanout.

planner_mode.description: Discovery planner: observe emits metrics; enforce applies candidate-backed signal caps.

brand_aliases.description: Optional public brand aliases to seed, such as product or legal-entity labels.

candidate_domains.description: Optional candidate domains supplied by the caller for corroboration.

discovery_mode.description: Discovery pipeline: classic = legacy sweep; tiered = tenant/graph/evidence lookups first.

ownership_verified.description: Attest you own or may scan these domains. Required for "tiered" unless enterprise/owner/partner.

tools.name: brand_audit_status
tools.description: Poll the status of an enqueued brand audit. Returns audit-level status (queued | running | completed | failed), progress 'N/M', and per-target statuses. Owner-scoped — auditIds owned by other principals surface as notFound.

tools.name: brand_audit_get_report
tools.description: Fetch the result JSON of a completed brand audit: the per-target CheckResult when `target` is set, else the audit-level aggregate; returns notReady while in flight. When a PDF sidecar exists, metadata includes pdfUrl, an authenticated /reports/ download link (same bearer credential). Targets whose PDF is still rendering include pdfPending, so poll again.

target.description: Specific target domain. Omit for audit-level aggregate.

tools.name: list_brand_audit_watches
tools.description: Returns the caller's recurring brand-audit watches: watchId, domain, interval, webhook presence, last-run time, and active state. Owner-scoped. Read-only.

tools.name: register_brand_audit_watch
tools.description: Creates a recurring brand-audit watch for a domain on a daily/weekly/monthly cadence. Each run enqueues a fresh brand_audit_batch_start and (when a webhook is configured) POSTs a diff webhook on classification drift. Returns the new watchId. Owner-scoped; per-principal cap of 20 active watches.

webhook_url.description: Optional webhook URL, POSTed on classification drift. SSRF-validated at register and delivery.

tools.name: delete_brand_audit_watch
tools.description: Permanently removes a recurring brand-audit watch by watchId. Owner-scoped — a watchId owned by another principal surfaces as notFound. Returns confirmation of deletion.

tools.name: scan_buckets_start
tools.description: Start an async cloud-bucket discovery scan for a target domain. Operator-deploy only; targets must be on the recon watchlist; degrades to info when unprovisioned. Returns a scanId (valid 24h) — poll progress with scan_buckets_status and retrieve results with scan_buckets_findings.

target.description: Domain whose cloud buckets to discover (e.g. example.com).

providers.description: Cloud providers to scan (max 8, e.g. aws, gcp, azure). All providers if omitted.

tools.name: scan_buckets_status
tools.description: Poll the status of a cloud-bucket discovery scan by scanId from scan_buckets_start. Operator-deploy only; degrades to info when unprovisioned. Returns scan status (running | completed | failed) and progress metadata.

tools.name: scan_buckets_findings
tools.description: Retrieve findings from a completed cloud-bucket discovery scan by scanId. Operator-deploy only; degrades to info when unprovisioned. The scanId is required so reads can be owner-scoped; target and provider filters are optional.

target.description: Restrict findings to this domain. All scanned targets if omitted.

providers.description: Restrict findings to these cloud providers (max 8). All providers if omitted.

tools.name: osint_investigate_domain_start
tools.description: Start an async OSINT investigation for a domain. Operator-deploy only; targets must be on the recon watchlist; degrades to info when unprovisioned. Returns an investigationId (valid 24h) — poll with osint_investigation_status and retrieve results with osint_investigation_report.

query.description: Investigation subject, per tool: a domain, public IP, organisation name, email address or username.

tools.name: osint_investigate_infrastructure_start
tools.description: Start an async deep-infrastructure OSINT investigation for a query (domain, IP, or org). Operator-deploy only; targets must be on the recon watchlist; degrades to info when unprovisioned. Returns an investigationId (valid 24h) — poll with osint_investigation_status, then osint_investigation_report.

tools.description: Start an async supply-chain OSINT investigation for a query. Operator-deploy only; targets must be on the recon watchlist; degrades to info when unprovisioned. Returns an investigationId (valid 24h) — poll with osint_investigation_status, then osint_investigation_report.

query.description: Investigation subject, per tool: a domain, public IP, organisation name, email address or username.

tools.name: osint_investigate_username_start
tools.description: Start an async OSINT investigation for a username (cross-platform presence, breach correlation). Owner/enterprise tier only — people-centric OSINT is restricted to prevent misuse. Returns an investigationId (valid 24h) — poll with osint_investigation_status and retrieve results with osint_investigation_report.

query.description: Investigation subject, per tool: a domain, public IP, organisation name, email address or username.

tools.name: osint_investigate_email_start
tools.description: Start an async OSINT investigation for an email address (breach exposure, account correlation). Owner/enterprise tier only — people-centric OSINT is restricted to prevent misuse. Returns an investigationId (valid 24h) — poll with osint_investigation_status and retrieve results with osint_investigation_report.

query.description: Investigation subject, per tool: a domain, public IP, organisation name, email address or username.

tools.name: osint_investigation_status
tools.description: Poll the status of an OSINT investigation by investigationId from an osint_investigate_*_start tool. Operator-deploy only; degrades to info when unprovisioned. Returns current status (running | completed | failed) and progress metadata.

investigationId.description: Investigation ID returned by an osint_investigate_*_start tool.

tools.name: osint_investigation_report
tools.description: Retrieve the final report of a completed OSINT investigation by investigationId. For a deep_infrastructure investigation the report also composes discover_subdomains for the target (a cached CT sample under `ctDiscovery`, never an inventory). Operator-deploy only; degrades to info when unprovisioned or not yet complete.

investigationId.description: Investigation ID returned by an osint_investigate_*_start tool.
